messages:
sam (Sales): Hey team — prospect (FinTech) just sent a SIG/CAIQ subset and wants IAM artifacts for the POC: SSO/SAML metadata, proof MFA is enforced, RBAC role matrix, and examples of least-privilege service accounts. They want these by EOD today. who can pull a trimmed bundle?

maya (Security): I can. I'll prepare a POC bundle with: sanitized SAML metadata, MFA policy screenshot, RBAC CSV, and a short signed statement about service account controls. Uploading shortly :white_check_mark:

alex (Solutions Eng): For POC sharing we usually include:
- SP metadata (sanitized)
- example SAML Assertion (no PII)
- MFA policy excerpt + screenshot from Okta Admin
- RBAC mapping CSV and a sample role-binding JSON for our API
I can redact internal IDs.

sam (Sales): Quick question from the buyer: is MFA "required for all users" or are service accounts exempt? need exact language to put in the questionnaire.

maya (Security): MFA is required for all interactive user accounts. Service accounts are handled via short-lived tokens + automated rotation; they do not use interactive MFA. I'll paste the policy blurb so you can quote it.

maya (Security): ```
MFA Enforcement:
- interactive_users: REQUIRED (2FA via Okta)
- service_accounts: TOKEN_BASED (rotated keys, 7d TTL)
- exceptions: none without documented approval
Audit: all auth events forwarded to SIEM with 90d retention
```

jordan (Account Exec): Buyer also asked for a least-privilege matrix for two POC roles: "poc_viewer" and "poc_developer" — can we include a simple table or CSV?

alex (Solutions Eng): Yep — example CSV lines:
role,permissions
poc_viewer,models:list;models:status;logs:read
poc_developer,models:invoke;prompts:create;prompts:update
I'll export and attach to Confluence.

maya (Security): Note for the RFP: we enforce SCIM provisioning for customer SSO + JIT role mapping for production. For POCs we create scoped accounts with expiry (7 days) and document that in the cover letter. I'll add a signed statement about technical controls and key rotation.

sam (Sales): Customer also wants a sanitized fragment of the SAML metadata XML to validate endpoints — can someone paste a short snippet we can quote?

alex (Solutions Eng): ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://auth.redwood.ai/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

maya (Security): Uploaded the bundle and cover letter to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/POC-IAM-123. Also created a short PDF that states: "MFA required for interactive users; service accounts use token rotation; RBAC is scoped and auditable." Ping me if they ask for a signed ATO.

sam (Sales): Great — I'll send this to the prospect now and flag any follow-ups. Thanks all :rocket:

jira-bot: Created page RED-1123: 'POC IAM artifacts bundle' (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1123)
